landing_pages.intro:
Kochi stretches from Fort Kochi to Aluva, so patients weigh distance as much as reputation. Many of those checks happen online, before the first call.

  • Distance and traffic: patients compare how far a clinic is from home or work, often across bridges and busy junctions.
  • Branch details: for clinic groups, patients look for the nearest branch's hours, doctors and directions on Google Maps.
  • Doctor qualifications: specialist training and registration details help patients compare doctors for planned treatments such as implants or eye surgery.
  • Response speed: an unanswered call or a slow WhatsApp reply can send the patient straight to the next listing.

landing_pages.overview:
How we plan: three steps from first audit to patient walk-ins. We audit what you run today, launch channels by locality, then keep refining against walk-ins, not clicks or leads. First you tell us about your clinic — your centres, treatments, targets and the problems you are facing. Then we map the gaps, reviewing your ads, Maps listings, calls and CRM to find where patients drop off. Finally you get a proven plan, scoped to start within 5 km of each centre, with monthly walk-in reviews built in.

No office visit needed — we come to your clinic or hospital. At onboarding our team spends time with your reception staff and checks how enquiries are answered and logged, then returns on a schedule set with you to cover results and anything to fix on site. Calls are scored out of 100 with weekly coaching, and we configure your existing CRM if it captures source and outcome or set up MedLift. We cover Edappally, Kakkanad, Palarivattom, Kaloor, Vyttila, Kadavanthra, Panampilly Nagar, Aluva and nearby areas. To schedule an onboarding visit, call our team on +91 7428094567.

faqs.q: How do you choose the best digital marketing company in Kochi for a clinic or hospital?
faqs.a: Look at three things: proven healthcare experience, client success stories you can verify, and transparent communication. Then add a fourth: whether the company reports walk-ins or stops at leads. Every ad it runs should also show the doctor's registration details, as the NMC guidelines require.

faqs.q: Is it worth hiring a digital marketing company in Kochi?
faqs.a: It is worth it when your current marketing cannot show which channel brings patients. A specialist team brings call tracking, attribution and NMC-compliant execution that are hard to build alone. If your setup already tracks walk-ins by channel, the case for hiring is weaker.

faqs.q: How do you market a clinic group with branches across Kochi?
faqs.a: Each branch gets its own Google Maps profile, location page and area-based campaigns, so enquiries can be traced to the branch the patient chose. Shared details such as doctors and timings stay consistent everywhere, which helps search engines and AI tools describe the group correctly.

faqs.q: What should a Kochi clinic fix before running Google Ads?
faqs.a: Four things: a complete Google Maps profile, a phone line that gets answered, a landing page with clear treatment details, and the doctor's registration information on every ad. Without these, ad spend brings enquiries that are hard to convert and harder to track.

faqs.q: Can IVF and eye care clinics in Kochi advertise success rates?
faqs.a: No. The NMC guidelines of 6 October 2026 bar success rates and patient numbers in a doctor's or clinic's advertising. IVF and eye care clinics can promote accredited facilities, specialist qualifications, diagnostic equipment and factual information about procedures instead.

faqs.q: How often will your team visit our clinic in Kochi?
faqs.a: Our team visits your clinic at onboarding and on a regular schedule after that. The schedule is agreed with you at onboarding. Between visits, call scores, coaching notes and walk-in data on your dashboard keep progress visible.
